Name: Lucky the Parasaurolophus- Horse Replacer
Author: saurianne
Description:
I'm not sure the Venn Diagram of "People who play Paleo Pines" and "People who play modded Stardew Valley" is bigger than myself, but someone made a mod adding Lucky to JWE so I felt compelled to [s]bring balance to the Force[/s] put her in a game where she probably wouldn't get eaten and whipped this up in the course of a morning.

Lucky is a character from the game Paleo Pines by Italic Pig. She's the player character's first dinosaur, and a character in her own right. If you're familiar with the game, have fun running around with her in Stardew. If you're not, enjoy the cute parasaur and consider checking out Paleo Pines, it's a lovely game.

Version 2.0 is here! Lucky's sprites have been improved, she now has carrot eating animations (though I may need to clean those up later) complete with happy flowers, and you now have the option to have Horse: The Book have Lucky's face on it and for the Horse Flute to look like the flute from Paleo Pines.

Downloads.Description: Now more up to date for 1.6, improves on Lucky's sprites and optionally recolors the Horse Flute and Horse: The Book as well
